Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 132. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 20 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
Collect all of your energy to your arms for a lightning
fast attack. Roll a Combo attack roll dealing your
equipped weapon’s damage die + 3d8 damage on a hit.
